name: hettie
description: Publish and run websites from your chat: pages, posts, leads, analytics, media, domains and A/B experiments on Hettie.

interface.longDescription: Hettie hosts websites made in chat. Publish a site's pages straight from the conversation, move a site from Lovable or ChatGPT Sites, connect your own domain, and see visits, leads and where they came from. Write blog posts, upload media and run A/B tests on pages. Sign in with your Hettie account. Hettie never changes your DNS: you add the records it shows at your registrar.
defaultPrompt: Show me this week's leads on my Hettie sites.
Put my Hettie site on my own domain.
